hero.title: Dual Subtitles for Netflix, YouTube, Prime & 5 more
hero.subtitle: Turn Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, Apple TV, Crunchyroll, Udemy, and Coursera into an immersive language lesson. Research shows learners who use dual subtitles retain up to 50% more vocabulary than traditional methods. Funlingo supports 100+ languages with bilingual subtitles, instant AI definitions, and vocabulary building — a completely free alternative to paid extensions. Rated 4.92/5 stars on the Chrome Web Store.

home.heroSub: Dual subtitles, instant word meanings, and a vocab builder — right inside Netflix, YouTube, Prime & 5 more. Pick a language and try the player.
home.ratingTail: on the Chrome Web Store · loved by language learners
home.platformHeading: One extension. Works everywhere you already watch & learn.

home.step2Body: Open Netflix, YouTube, Prime — 8 platforms in all — and watch what you already love.

home.rev1: Watching Netflix while picking up new words feels effortless now. The dual subtitles and instant meanings make everything click.
home.rev2: It's amazing how much my skills improved just by watching videos. It fits right into my daily routine.

home.q2: Which sites does it work on?

home.ctaSub: Add Funlingo to Chrome and the next thing you watch is already teaching you. Free forever, no account needed.

roadmap.i11Body: Practise using the words you saved in short, real-life conversational prompts.

roadmap.i13Body: Take your saved words anywhere — export to the study tools you already use.

about.h1a: Learning a language should feel like a
about.sub: Funlingo started with a simple frustration: the best way to learn a language is the content you already love — so why does every tool make it feel like homework?
about.whyH2: The tools were powerful. They just weren't fun.
about.whyP1: Language Reactor, Trancy, the rest — genuinely capable, but built like study software. Dashboards. Setup. A monthly bill. They turned a Netflix night into a chore.
about.whyP2: We wanted the opposite. Open a show, see two subtitle lines, tap a word you don't know, keep watching. No account. No paywall. Learning that hides inside the thing you were already going to do.
about.quote: We acquire language in only one way — when we understand messages we actually care about.
about.quoteRole: The Input Hypothesis — the idea Funlingo is built on
about.p1Body: No premium tier, no trial that expires, no feature held hostage behind a card. Every part of Funlingo is free, and it stays that way.
about.p2Body: Words stick when they arrive in a sentence you care about — said by a character, in a scene. Not on a flashcard out of nowhere.
about.p3Body: No sign-up, no setup, no dashboard to configure. Install it, press play, and you're already learning in under 30 seconds.
about.p4Body: Not linguists, not power users — people who want to watch their show and pick up a language on the side. Simple wins.
about.ctaSub: It's free, it's already inside the apps you use, and it takes 30 seconds to start.
